meta.notes: Two-repo project: workflow infra (agentic_workflow) + MCP server (ptc-server). PTC feature spans both.

blocks.name: ptc-server
blocks.purpose: PTC V2 MCP server — persistent REPL pool with bridge networking
blocks.notes: V2 removed tool_dispatcher.py, tool_registry.py, ipc_sandbox.py, ptc_tools/. Containers use bridge networking + /workspace:rw. No tool dispatch — agents write direct Python.

blocks.name: agentic-workflow-infra
blocks.purpose: workflow orchestration infra, skills, tests for PTC

blocks.name: tests-ptc
blocks.purpose: existing tests for ptc-server (to be rewritten)

blocks.name: ptc-v2-implemented
blocks.purpose: PTC V2 — simplified REPL pool manager (replaces V1 tool dispatch architecture)
blocks.notes: Merged into ptc-server block above. V2 removed tool dispatch layer, enabled bridge networking, uses pre-built role images.

ptc-server.name: ReplHandle
ptc-server.usage: one REPL process in a container

ptc-server.name: IpcHost
ptc-server.usage: host-side Unix socket server per REPL

ptc-server.name: Executor
ptc-server.usage: code exec + persistent namespace in container

ptc-server.name: PtcEventLogger
ptc-server.usage: JSONL event logging for PTC events

configs.name: ptc-server config (V2)

fields.resource_limits: {memory_mb:1024, cpu_cores:1, timeout_seconds:60, max_containers:8, disk_mb:512, max_output_bytes:65536, idle_timeout_seconds:300, container_ttl_seconds:600}

configs.notes: V2: No role_tools, tool_strategies, or output_formats. No fallback config.

direct_python.style: agents write plain Python in ptc_execute — open(), requests.get(), subprocess.run()
direct_python.note: V2: no tool stubs, no await tool_name() pattern. Bridge networking + /workspace:rw enables direct access.

ipc_protocol.style: NDJSON over Unix domain socket bind-mounted into container

repl_pool.style: multiple Python processes per container, shared packages, independent namespaces
repl_pool.startup_cost: container creation: ~1-2s (pre-built image); new REPL: ~100ms (docker exec)

error_handling.style: return JSON error dict, never re-execute on crash
error_handling.crash_recovery: return error to agent; agent retries if needed
